title: Longest Palindromic Substring
summary: Return a longest contiguous substring that reads the same forward and backward.

contractDetails.output-checking: Accept any contiguous palindrome whose length matches the canonical maximum. Letter case matters.

statement: Return a longest contiguous substring that reads the same forward and backward. Match characters exactly, including letter case. If several substrings tie, any one is valid.

examples.explanation: The seven-letter prefix mirrors around its center.
The longest palindrome has an even length.
Both aba and cdc have maximum length three.

hints: Conceptual: Each palindrome has a middle.
Directional: A middle can be a character or the gap between two characters.
Implementation: Expand in both directions from every possible center and keep a longest successful span.
complexityAnalysis: O(n²) time and O(1) extra space excluding the returned substring.
